fact: On 28 January 2026 (International Data Protection Day) ANPDP director José Costa Alegre gave a press briefing reviewing the agency's activity, including its accompaniment of public and private entities in complying with data protection legislation, and citing resource constraints.
title: Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados destaca progressos e alerta para riscos à privacidade digital
publisher: Rádio Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe (rstp.st)
